The Edron orcs keep a small treasure in their cave. Go down four floors of the Edron Orc Cave, face groups of {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} and {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders} and open the box at the end of the last floor to receive 3 {item:White Pearl|White Pearls} and 175 gp.
Edron's orcs guard a small treasure in their cave.
Edron Orc Cave entrance, southwest of the castle
Area runes or spells (for example {item:Stoneshower Rune|Stoneshower Runes}, {spell:Berserk} or {spell:Groundshaker})
{creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} come in groups: use area runes or spells whenever possible.
This cave has other quests (for example the {wiki:Dark Armor Quest|Dark Armor Quest}): it's worth doing them on the same trip.

If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
Enter the **Edron Orc Cave**, southwest of Edron castle. You can also get there through a sewer in the basement of the {wiki:Edron Flats} (the apartments just south of the castle).

On the first underground floor you only meet {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}. Go to the **south** end of the floor and go down to -2.
Floor -1: path to the south end

Here there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}, {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors} and maybe one or two {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} pulled by other players. Go to the crossroads and quickly go down to -3, avoiding unnecessary fights.

As soon as you go down you're attacked by several {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and one or two {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}. Use area attacks: {spell:Berserk} or {spell:Groundshaker} if you're a knight, {item:Stoneshower Rune|Stoneshower Runes} if you're a mage or paladin.
Floor -3: path east to the hole
After getting rid of the attack, head **east** and go down through another hole.

At the bottom of the hole you find up to 6 {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}. Use area runes or spells. Advance slowly to the **east** end of the floor, facing more Orc Berserkers and 1 to 4 {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}.
Floor -4: path to the treasure box
The room below, right before the White Pearls room, has several Orc Berserkers and Orc Warriors.
The treasure is in a box at the end of the floor, as the map shows. Open it.

Go back the same way: on each floor return to the hole you fell through and use the {item:Rope} to climb up (following the same maps in reverse). On the first floor head back **north** to the entrance and exit to the surface, southwest of the castle. At Edron's port, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities.
Below the room before the White Pearls room there are two more boxes, where you can also find a {item:Barbarian Axe} and a {item:Scimitar}.
